label: Insects and spiders
description: Named insects, spiders and other small terrestrial invertebrates, including scorpions, centipedes and snails.
notes: Recognizable insects, arachnids and a few familiar small terrestrial invertebrates belong here. animal.sea_life holds aquatic invertebrates and animal.species holds the broader animal backbone. Values use singular common names with their own indefinite article; the kind chips are browsing groups rather than a strict taxonomy. Adult wing and body forms are used unless the name explicitly identifies a caterpillar.
